title: Crispy Falafel Wrap
description: A delicious and crispy falafel wrap with a side of tasty aerated slaw. Perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: 1. Preheat a pan or griddle over medium heat.
2. Cook the falafel mix according to the package instructions.
3. Warm the Dutch wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
4. Spread 2 tbsp of airy hummus on the wrap.
5. Add the cooked falafel on top of the hummus.
6. Add a cup of aerated coleslaw mix on top of the falafel.
7. Sprinkle chopped fresh parsley on top.
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
